notes: Force protection is back as a base facility instead of a combat unit: build it under Facilities in three levels, from a guard force on the gates and towers up to full entry control points and a reaction force. It never leaves the wire. Each level adds base defense and 120 people toward running the base, and a base with force protection stays held when its combat companies are out. Garrison security companies in saved campaigns become force protection at their base

AC-130 gunship missions now orbit the target: after the first pass the gunship circles for about an hour and keeps firing, wearing the target down and taking pressure off any troops in contact nearby, before heading home
